stem: Kavita sketches a star pattern she saw from her terrace. She joins several bright stars with pencil lines so her classmates can recognize the shape.

statements.text: The pencil lines are imaginary guides drawn only to help identify the star pattern.
The pencil lines are real glowing threads stretched between the stars in the sky.
A constellation drawing shows an identification pattern, not physical lines in the sky.

teacher.key_rationale: Constellation lines are identification patterns drawn for recognition. They are not real threads in the sky.
